name: It's You Again and Again
source:
Kali is out on a first date with someone he met online. A charming wolf named Raphael. It seems to go well, but will the relationship survive Kali's strange, supernatural secret?

[From [url=https://knowit01.itch.io/its-you-again-and-again]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡利和他在网上认识的人第一次约会。一只名叫拉斐尔的迷人狼。看起来进展顺利，但这段关系能在卡莉奇怪的超自然秘密中幸存下来吗？

[来自[url=https://knowit01.itch.io/its-you-again-and-again]Itch.io[/url]]
